item: B1 - GEOVAR header grammar beyond the legacy whitelist
native: Sonnet Lite 18.53 (installed), em intake + full solve

grammar.kind_axis: positional, case-insensitive; kind in ANC/SYM/RAD, axis in XDIR/YDIR; kind/axis position swaps reject (Geo Variable Type Keyword not understood)
grammar.tail: tokens after the axis are scanned in order: the first NSCD/SCUNI/SCXY keyword sets scaling, the first finite numeric token sets the display direction (sign-normalized; nonnegative -> +1). Unknown tokens reject while scaling is unset and are ignored once scaling appears. Missing tail defaults to direction +1 and NSCD; a bare four-token header is legal.
grammar.direction_semantics: the display direction is ignored for application whenever the saved reference span is nonzero - every dimension resolves along sign(span)*target; only a zero span falls back to the parsed sign (verified bit-identical across dir fields -2,-1,0,1,2,3,99,-1.7,1e2,+1 on ANC, SYM and SCXY dims)
grammar.case: all structural record keywords are case-insensitive (ftyp, ver, geo/end geo, box, tmet, bmet, met, num, via polygon, bri poly, tlaynam, tolevel, por1, poly, cupgrp, smd, id, type, gndref, simple, end, valvar, geovar + body keywords pos/nom/eqn/ref1/ref2/ps1/ps2/poly, kind/axis/scaling). DIM unit entries (ANG, CAP, ...) and VARSWP block contents (SWPVARS, ENABLED, FREQ, ABS_ENTRY) are case-SENSITIVE natively and remain strict.
grammar.eqn: the optional EQN record can sit directly after NOM or after REF2 (both positions verified natively)
